state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place).** The gap `powmod-and-pow-followed-by-mod` is closed. `Core\BigInt::powMod` returns the least non-negative residue modulo `|$modulus|` for every receiver and either sign of modulus, which `POW_MOD_DOC`'s `ret` states. The Rust test `pow_mod_returns_the_least_non_negative_residue` and the conformance case `tests/conformance/core/bigint-number-theory-members-answer-their-own-identities.nvst` (`residue 1 but remainder -6`) pin it. `Core\BigInt`'s perf is re-measured.

`php-oracle-retired`'s `nvs-stdlib-the-m11-decisions-hold` check still names one test that does not exist: `a_search_never_matches_inside_a_grapheme`. Its design is settled in `docs/agent/goals/php-oracle-retired.md` § the first bullet at line 234.

The only `nvs-runtime` gap left is `enum-case-that-reached-a-mixed`. It needs an ADR beyond Stage 5's one slot, so it waits for the user. It goes to `BLOCKED` only once it is the last goal-owned gap in the tree.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes. A person has to push.

A change to a `Core` implementation file stales the perf figure of every feature it implements. Re-measure each with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group <class>`.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest, in `nvs-lsp`, `nvs-stdlib`, `nvs-syntax`, `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`.

It holds for the whole family: `indexOf` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:2895`), `lastIndexOf`, `contains` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/str.rs:1958`), `countOf`, `before`, `after`, `split`, `replace`. Add the Rust test `a_search_never_matches_inside_a_grapheme`, turn the gap's four examples into conformance cases, delete `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/a-match-inside-a-character-reports-the-wrong-position.json`, and re-measure `Core\Str`'s perf.
